name: Abkhazia cryptocurrency mining technopark (de-facto context)
notes: De-facto/occupied-territory crypto-mining and technopark reports only; per GE methodology this is EXCLUDED from the Georgian official enumeration (no reliable Georgian official permit/cadastre coverage). Recorded for coverage completeness, not counted as commercial colocation.

name: Cloud9 - Batumi Arena data center
notes: DataCenterMap lists Cloud9 Batumi Arena at Shartava Ave 13, Batumi as under construction with 0.1 MW reported (catalog capacity, grade C). No first-party Cloud9 confirmation, Batumi permit or utility evidence found; per methodology not counted until first-party/municipal confirmation.

name: Kutaisi Technology Hub data center / AI computing center (former Parliament building)
notes: Kutaisi Technology Hub opened on 24 July 2026 in the former Parliament building, run by GITA, including a tech park, TUMO school, AI computing center and labs (official 1TV/rustavi2 reporting; AGP industry report). The data-center/computing component is part of the public hub; no public MW or commercial colo offering published.

name: Innovative Technology LLC datacenter services facility (Ruispiri/Telavi)
notes: Company site is live (2026-08-12) advertising IT/AMC services; prior-round datacenter service page advertises colocation, server hosting, backup and DR from Ruispiri village, Telavi district. No municipal permit/cadastre or capacity evidence found; catalog/service-page level only.

name: Bitfury Gori bitcoin mining data center
notes: Trade press (incl. 2026 reports) confirm Bitfury built a ~20 MW bitcoin-mining data center in Gori in 2014; historical facility. Current ownership/operating status not reconfirmed from primary sources; treated as historical crypto/HPC infrastructure rather than current commercial colo per methodology.

name: GDKHOST.NET / LLC Ordunet small data center
notes: GDKHOST first-party pages claim hosting from its own small data center in Georgia with redundant cooling/power; network/IP evidence ties AS203136 LLC Ordunet to Zugdidi, Samegrelo-Zemo Svaneti (whatismyipaddress, RIPE member record). Capacity not disclosed; municipal permit/cadastre still unverified.

name: Cloud9 Dinamo Arena carrier-neutral data center
notes: First-party operator page (A) markets carrier-neutral Tbilisi DC at Dinamo Stadium / 2 Akaki Tsereteli Ave Gate 5 with 3 independent power substations, 630 kVA backup generator, N+N power feeds. Catalog capacity 0.5 MW is grade C; permit/cadastre still unverified.

name: Silknet / Silk Cloud Tier III certified commercial data center
notes: Silknet first-party plan (A) for Georgia's first Tier III certified commercial DC via Orange Polska/Integrated Solutions partnership; BM.ge (B, Aug 2026) reports official groundbreaking, 2 MW high-resilience capacity, operated by Silk Cloud subsidiary, commissioning expected 2027. Permit/NAPR/address/Uptime certification still to be verified.

name: Caucasus Online Datacenter - Tbilisi
notes: First-party service page (A) markets modern data center colocation with high-performance network, multi-tiered security, dual high-density power and redundant environmental systems. 3.0 MW capacity and exact site address are catalog-level (C); ComCom authorization and Tbilisi permit unverified.

name: NewTelco Georgia (NewTelco Tbilisi)
notes: First-party Georgian site (newtelco.ge) self-describes as the first international data center in Transcaucasia; group site (newtelco.com) lists NewTelco Georgia Ltd at A. Politkovskaia St, Tbilisi, neutral DC since 2012-2016. Address 5 Ana Politkovskaia St from business directories; 3.0 MW capacity is catalog-level (C).

name: G Data Data-Center #1
notes: Uptime Institute (browsed 2026-08-12) lists G Data LLC / G Data Data-Center #1, Tbilisi, Georgia with Tier III Certification of Design Documents only - design-certified (planned), not constructed/operational. No public capacity.

name: JSC Bank of Georgia Main DC (Lilo)
notes: Uptime Institute lists Tier III Certification of Design Documents + Tier III Certification of Constructed Facility for Bank of Georgia Main DC (Lilo), Tbilisi. PRIVATE bank data center - non-commercial context per methodology, recorded for completeness.

name: JSC TBC Bank TBL-01
notes: Uptime Institute lists Tier III Certification of Constructed Facility for TBC TBL-01, Tbilisi. PRIVATE bank data center - non-commercial context per methodology, recorded for completeness.

name: Bitfury Gldani / Tbilisi FIZ historical crypto data center
notes: Historical 40-60 MW (media references) crypto/HPC data center in/near Tbilisi Free Zone (Gldani); Bitfury first-party sale PDF (2018) and BM.ge confirm historical build and divestment. Current owner/operator and operating status undetermined - not counted as current commercial colo.

name: WORLDBUS Data Center
notes: First-party page (worldbus.ge/colocation/, A) markets colocation hosting services in Georgia with 99.9% uptime guarantee alongside Istanbul facilities. Tbilisi facility address (5 Oqromchedelebi St) and 3.0 MW capacity are catalog-level (C); no detailed Tbilisi facility spec page found.

name: Proservice Data Center
notes: Art House Architects lists Proservice Data Center as a completed 2013 Tbilisi project; DataCenterMap and business directory place it at P. Kavtaradze dead end 3, Tbilisi. No operator first-party page or capacity found - catalog/architect level only.
